link_convention.rationale: Task files live at work/11-funnels-interactive/tasks/N.md. Markdown links in these files resolve relative to the file's own directory, so reaching the repo root requires the ../../../ prefix. Verified on disk: '../../../.claude/skills/project-knowledge/references/patterns.md' resolves; bare '.claude/skills/project-knowledge/references/patterns.md' does NOT resolve from the task dir.
link_convention.note: The task.md.template uses bare '.claude/skills/project-knowledge/<file>.md' (no 'references/' subdir and no ../../../ prefix). The template is doubly wrong for this repo's task location: (1) it omits the file-relative prefix, (2) the real PK files live under a 'references/' subdirectory. The canonical correct form is established by sibling tasks 2 and 5 in this same feature, which use the ../../../ + references/ form. Tasks 1, 3, 4 now match that canonical form.
